2. This anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the above-named applicant seeking
anticipatory bail in connection with Khelari P.S. Case No. 41 of 2022, registered under Sections
498A/304B/34 of the Indian Penal Code and section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, pending in
the court of the learned Sdjm, Ranchi.

3.  Learned Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the FIR of this case was lodged under sections 498A/304B r/w 34 of IPC and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act against the six named accused including the petitioner.

The allegation made against the petitioner is that he used to abet the husband of deceased for the second marriage and there is no allegations against the petitioner in regard to any alleged demand of dowry for committing dowry death.

4. Learned A.P.P. appearing on behalf of the State vehemently opposed the contentions made by the learned counsel for the applicant and contended that it was petitioner, who used to abet the husband to torture her so that he could remarry with another lady.
5.

As per prosecution case, the daughter of the informant was married with Dilip Kumar in the year 2019 and all the named accused in the FIR had harassed the daughter of informant for non-fulfillment of demand of dowry.
On 09.08.2021 informant received information that the dowry death of his daughter has been committed by all the accused persons.

He reached the in-laws house of his daughter and found the dead body and nearby the dead body of the daughter, he found suicide note which was written on the wall by the lipstick in which the husband Dilip Kumar, sister-in-law Pintu Kumar Das vs The State Of Jharkhand .... ....

Usha Devi and friend of the husband i.e. Pintu were made responsible for suicide of the deceased.
6. In this FIR, the allegations which is made against the petitioner is in regard to abetting the husband of deceased only for second marriage.
Admittedly petitioner is the friend of the husband of the deceased.
He is not the beneficiary of any alleged demand of dowry.
There is nothing in the FIR or on record to show that the petitioner was also residing alongwith family of the husband of deceased.
So far as the alleged suicide note which is written on the wall by the red color lipstick

,
there is no evidence against the petitioner in regard to complicity of applicant.
7. In view of the evidence collected by the IO which is in case diary, no useful purpose would be served in keeping the present application pending or calling for counter affidavit from the State.
Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the applicant is entitled to be released on anticipatory bail.
Accordingly, prayer for anticipatory bail of the applicant is hereby allowed.

8. In the event of arrest, let the applicant be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the court concerned on the following conditions :-
i.
The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required.

ii. The applicant shall not, directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade himself from disclosing such facts to the court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.

iii. In default of any of the conditions mentioned above, the investigating officers shall be at liberty to file appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail granted to the applicant.
iv. The applicant shall co
- operate in the trial before the court below and in case of non-cooperation, the trial court would be at liberty to cancel the bail of the applicant without any reference to this Court.
